List the arms of every governed span of a document

Source: R/arms.R
arms.Rd

Reads one or more .qmd or .Rmd files with the scanner and lists, for every n, if, sign and list span, each of its arms: the span's place, the key and its expression, the arm's role and the text the author wrote. The spans are those in prose, in captions, in front-matter fields and in literal weft_str() strings. No R is run: the file is parsed, never evaluated, so an expression that stops, writes a file or names an unknown object does nothing.

Usage

arms(file)

Arguments

file

One path, or several, to documents.

Value

A data frame of class weft_arms, one row per arm, with the columns file, line (where the span starts), context, span (the span's number in the result, in document order), key ("n", "if", "sign" or "list"), expr (the key's value), arm (the arm's index in its span), role ("always", "one", "other", "zero", "two", "true", "false", "positive" or "negative"), text (the arm as written, trimmed), and parent_span and parent_arm (the span and arm it is nested in, or NA).

Details

A file with a construct error is still listed. The errors are in the attribute errors, and the print method ends with them. A span whose arm count is not one the key accepts is not listed; it is one of the errors. So is an n span with more than one arm in a document whose lang is not English, because weft ships no other plural rules (rules 1.6.4, 1.6.5).

Only the spans of the files given are listed; a document that a chunk includes with child= is listed only when it is given too.

See also

rehearse(), which knits a document under several sets of parameters and reports which arms they chose.
